faq: What is an event tracking plan?
A structured document listing every user interaction you'll track and the properties sent with each. It's the spec your engineers implement against.
What are the three property types?

Event properties, tied to a single action. Profile properties, tied to the user and reflecting their current state. Super properties, attached to every event after they're set — without rewriting the past.
How do you decide whether to track something?
Ask whether losing it costs you an insight you'd act on. If not, leave it out. That single test is what keeps a plan at 25 events instead of 200.
Why does a tracking plan matter so much?

Because everything downstream inherits it. Without one you get add_to_cart, AddToCart and btn_atc meaning the same thing, three numbers that disagree, and no reason to trust any dashboard built on top.
